sentences.en: A long time ago, people were very different from the way we are now.
sentences.zh: 很久以前，人们和我们现在的样子很不一样。

sentences.en: For example, if you find a really old house somewhere, you’ll see that the doors are usually much lower than they are today.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你在某个地方找到一座很老的房子，你会看到它的门通常比现在的门矮得多。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because hundreds of years ago, people were shorter.
sentences.zh: 因为几百年前，人们更矮。

sentences.en: Over time, the human body changes to adapt to a new way of life.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，人体会改变来适应新的生活方式。

sentences.en: Can we expect the human body to change in the future?
sentences.zh: 我们能预期人体在未来发生变化吗？

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 当然能。

sentences.en: And the main reason is that we have more and more technology, and it is changing how we live.
sentences.zh: 主要原因是我们的科技越来越多，它正在改变我们的生活方式。

sentences.en: What kind of changes can we expect?
sentences.zh: 我们能预期哪些变化？

sentences.en: Well, no one can be 100 percent sure, but here are some possibilities.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没人能 100% 确定，但这里有一些可能的变化。

sentences.en: Let’s start with the example above.
sentences.zh: 我们先从上面的例子说起。

sentences.en: Humans are now ten centimetres taller than 150 years ago.
sentences.zh: 现在的人比 150 年前高十厘米。

sentences.en: So, in the future, people will probably be even taller.
sentences.zh: 所以在未来，人们可能会更高。

sentences.en: Most of us now have much better food than people in the past – and so we grow more.
sentences.zh: 我们现在大多数人的食物比过去的人好得多，所以我们也长得更高。

sentences.en: We’ll get weaker in more than one way.
sentences.zh: 我们会在不止一个方面变得更弱。

sentences.en: The most important way is that our muscles will not be as strong as now because we won’t do a lot of physical work.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点是，我们的肌肉不会像现在这么强壮，因为我们不会做很多体力活。

sentences.en: We are already using our feet less, and our hands more (think about computers and tablets and so on).
sentences.zh: 我们已经较少用脚，更多用手（想想电脑、平板等等）。

sentences.en: So we can expect that our legs will get shorter and our feet smaller, and at the same time, our fingers will get longer.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以预期，我们的腿会变短，脚会变小，同时手指会变长。

sentences.en: And our fingers and our eyes will both get better because they’ll have to do more work together.
sentences.zh: 而且我们的手指和眼睛都会变得更好，因为它们要一起做更多工作。

sentences.en: Now, what about the mouth?
sentences.zh: 那么，嘴呢？

sentences.en: It’ll get smaller, perhaps, because technological improvements will mean that we don’t need to talk so much – and also because our teeth will get smaller (so mouths don’t need to be so big to keep them in).
sentences.zh: 它可能会变小，因为技术进步意味着我们不需要说那么多话，也因为我们的牙齿会变小（所以嘴不需要那么大才能装下它们）。

sentences.en: Here’s a good one – it’s very possible that people will have four toes, not five.
sentences.zh: 这条很有意思——很可能人们会有四个脚趾，而不是五个。

sentences.en: The little toe really isn’t needed anymore (people who lose them don’t miss them), so it will probably disappear sometime in the future.
sentences.zh: 小脚趾真的不再需要了（失去小脚趾的人也不会想念它们），所以它可能会在未来某个时候消失。

sentences.en: And last but not least – people won’t have as much hair on their bodies as now, as we don’t need it to keep ourselves warm anymore.
sentences.zh: 最后一点——人们身上的毛发不会像现在这么多，因为我们不再需要它来保暖。

sentences.en: Will all these things happen?
sentences.zh: 这些事情都会发生吗？

sentences.en: And if so, when?
sentences.zh: 如果会，什么时候？

sentences.en: These are questions that no one can answer for sure.
sentences.zh: 这些是没有人能肯定回答的问题。
